card.name: Inside words ending in -itis
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a long inflammation word just before the ending -itis, such as the ary in pharyngitis, unct in conjunctivitis, or yst in cholecystitis. It appears in lists of infections and inflammatory conditions.

modes.label: Pharyngitis
modes.description: The 'ary' piece inside nasopharyngitis or pharyngitis, in lists of respiratory infections.

modes.label: Other -itis words
modes.description: Middle pieces of conjunctivitis, cholecystitis, tonsillitis or fasciitis.

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like conj, bron, neur and mening, which begin other medical condition names.
card.plain: It fires partway through a long condition name that ends in -itis, such as pharyngitis or conjunctivitis.
